Depreciation Entry

The Depreciation Entry view displays detailed information about a depreciation entry that has been recorded in your accounting system.

Depreciation entries reduce the value of your fixed assets over time to reflect their declining value and usage.

From this view, you can see the date, reference number, and line items that make up the depreciation entry. Click the Edit button to modify the entry details or correct any errors.

For more information, see: Depreciation Entry — Edit
